verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents several natural-language surfaces. PR chat lets you ask follow-ups, challenge recommendations and explore alternatives. Learnings are taught through natural-language chat. A Slack agent investigates code, Sentry errors and Jira issues in natural language, and Change Stack offers chat pinned to a review snapshot. Claude Code can also trigger reviews through simple commands. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as described, and evidence that core controls (pause, resume, full review, configuration) accept free-form language rather than fixed @coderabbitai command keywords.
